{
  "name": "waypoints",
  "displayName": "Waypoints",
  "version": "2.1.0",
  "description": "A route for /goal and any multi-step work, built from Claude's own task plan: the plan drawn as a line of nodes and legs above the prompt, an ETA at the goal's own pace, a pane that opens by itself with the whole task trail, and every chat's goal in /waypoints. Follows Agent-Pulse's palette and animation. Claude is asked to plan by the mod itself. Fork of Nate Herk's goal-meter 1.0.0.",
  "author": {
    "name": "afterever"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/afterever/claude-mods/tree/master/waypoints",
  "repository": "https://github.com/afterever/claude-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "userConfig": {
    "palette": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Palette",
      "description": "follow uses Agent-Pulse's palette (ember when it is not installed); ember is Claude's warm orange range, claude follows your theme, neon is bioluminescent sea colors, mono keeps color for what needs you",
      "default": "follow",
      "options": [
        "follow",
        "ember",
        "claude",
        "neon",
        "mono"
      ]
    },
    "animation": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Animation",
      "description": "follow uses Agent-Pulse's level (subtle when it is not installed); off keeps everything still, subtle pulses the running task, full also breathes the node and sweeps the route when the plan finishes",
      "default": "follow",
      "options": [
        "follow",
        "off",
        "subtle",
        "full"
      ]
    },
    "pane": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pane",
      "description": "auto opens the Waypoints pane when a plan starts (it never takes the keys from the prompt, and waits on a narrow window); off opens it only when you ask with /waypoints or g",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "off"
      ]
    }
  },
  "keywords": [
    "goal",
    "progress",
    "tasks",
    "eta",
    "ui",
    "mod"
  ]
}
